title: Victor Calibration (VC): Multi-Pass Confidence Calibration and CP4.3 Governance Stress Test under Round-Table Orchestration

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating excessive refusal and hedging resulting from safety alignment training using a multi-pass protocol (Victor Calibration) to elicit a scalar confidence proxy, alongside behavior-only phenomenology audits (FD-Lite) tracking pressure markers like hedging, verbosity, and meta-prefixing.
